summary.value: Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice.

system.description: Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice. While the target is under the effect of this spell, if they suffer damage of the chosen type, they suffer 5 extra damage. Then, if that damage was caused by a creature, that creature recovers an amount of HP equal to half the total HP loss the target suffered. Once that happens, this spell ends.
